payload.content:
name: observability-plane-conformance
nodes:
  monitor:
    type: compute
    source:
      name: exact-monitor-image
      version: '*'
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    os_distribution: ubuntu
    os_version: '24.04'
    services:
    - port: 80
      protocol: tcp
      name: http
    runtime:
      service_listeners:
      - service_listener_id: telemetry
        service: http
        address: 0.0.0.0
        port: 80
        protocol: tcp
        address_family: ipv4
        scope: wildcard
evidence_requirements:
  listener-events:
    source_refs:
    - nodes.monitor.runtime.service_listeners.telemetry
    scope_refs:
    - nodes.monitor
    window: run
    channel: api_response
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: redact_sensitive
    integrity: checksum
    retention: not_retained
    loss_disclosure: required
    observation_demand:
      rule_id: listener-events
      scope: /nodes/monitor
      purpose: experimental
      mode: selected
      selector:
        semantic_scope: /nodes/monitor
        data_kind: stream
        names:
        - listener-events
      collection: require
      retention: disable
      export: disable
      redaction: redact-sensitive
      integrity: checksum
